name: 使用者の責に帰すべき事由による休業

references.title: 使用者の責に帰すべき事由による休業 (労働基準法 art.26: 休業手当 60% of the 平均賃金 (art.12) per scheduled day; excluded from the 全労働日 of the annual-leave 80% test, 平成25年7月10日 基発0710第3号) The 平均賃金 leaves out the periods art.12(3) lists, their days and their wages: occupational injury absence, 産前産後休業, an employer-caused suspension (suspension_kind EMPLOYER_CAUSED only, with the 休業手当 paid for it), 育児休業 (incl. 出生時育児休業), 介護休業 (earned.months leave_days, suspended_days_by_kind) and the probation period (terms.probation_until, its wages prorated by calendar days); where they cover the whole three months the wages and days of the period are used undivided (施行規則 art.3; 昭和24年4月11日 基発421号), and a worker paid by the day or hour is guaranteed 60% of the three months’ wages over the days worked (art.12(1)(i); worked_days).

name: 天災事変その他の不可抗力による休業

references.title: 天災事変その他の不可抗力による休業 (no 休業手当: not attributable to the employer, 労働基準法 art.26; excluded from the 全労働日, 基発0710第3号; e.g. a natural disaster or a scheduled power cut, 平成23年3月15日 基監発0315第1号)

name: 正当な争議行為（同盟罷業）

references.title: 正当な争議行為（同盟罷業）による不就労 (no wage for the days not worked, 民法 art.624(1); excluded from the 全労働日, 基発0710第3号; non-strikers idled by a partial strike are not owed 休業手当, 最判昭和62年7月17日)
正当なロックアウト (a defensive lockout releases the wage duty, 最判昭和50年4月25日 丸島水門事件; excluded from the 全労働日, 基発0710第3号; an unjustified lockout is EMPLOYER_CAUSED)

name: 法令・行政命令による休業

references.title: 法令・行政命令による休業 (a closure or work restriction ordered under law, e.g. 感染症法 art.18 就業制限: not attributable to the employer, no 休業手当; excluded from the 全労働日 as force majeure, 基発0710第3号)

name: 正当理由なく就労拒否された期間（無効解雇等）

references.title: Annual leave attendance for employer wrongful refusal or invalid dismissal
references.quote: A period the employee could not work because of wrongful employer refusal, including a dismissal established invalid, remains in total working days and is deemed attended. This attendance category does not compute the separate back-wage liability.
